rationale: Verified telemetry supports continued steady deceleration and places zero velocity 205 seconds after the forecast begins, beyond the 50-second horizon. This specifically falsifies tail_quadratic_decay, which changes curvature and reaches zero within the horizon. Although robust_seasonal_drift has substantially worse hindcast error and its seasonal assumption is unsupported, it is the only candidate that preserves a continuous decline while remaining above zero throughout the forecast interval.
